name: klais16-bauhaus
description: Two music videos for openKolibri/klais-16 - a colourful Bauhaus one and a red-only gothic one. Music, picture and encode are all generated by code.

scripts.geometry: node tools/extract-geometry.mjs "$KLAIS16" > src/geometry/klais16.json && node tools/extract-font.mjs "$KLAIS16" > src/geometry/font16.json
scripts.audio: node src/audio/render-audio.mjs build && node tools/audio-qa.mjs build
scripts.audio:gothic: node src/audio/render-audio-gothic.mjs build/gothic && node tools/audio-qa.mjs --edition gothic
scripts.build: npm run audio && npm run render
scripts.build:gothic: npm run audio:gothic && npm run render:gothic
